From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Deployment mode selection for Lumina Labs — follow-up & next steps

Diana,

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to hear more about Lumina's stack and migration priorities. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can scope the right deployment path: 

Recap
- Current production: mix of OpenAI API for chat front-ends + legacy self-hosted GPU cluster for specialized models.
- Primary goals: reduce token costs, improve tail latency for inference (target ~300ms p50/p90 for low-latency endpoints), and tighten security/compliance for PII-handling flows.
- Expected trajectory: 30–60M tokens/month in 6 months, with growth to ~100M in 12 months if experiments scale.

Clarifying questions (will help the recommendation):
1) What % of traffic contains regulated PII (PHI/PII)? If >10% you'll likely need Private/VPC or strict Dedicated with customer-managed keys.
2) For your specialized models on legacy GPU, are you planning to migrate those models to a hosted runtime or keep them on-prem?
3) What are the average/peak concurrency and average input sequence length for your high-priority endpoints?

Initial thoughts on deployment modes (high-level):
- Hosted API: fastest path to a POC with streaming and function-calling. Good if data sensitivity allows and you want to iterate quickly.
- Dedicated capacity: recommended if you need predictable throughput and isolation but still want Redwood-managed infra (we can reserve GPU pools sized to your peak throughput).
- Private (VPC / on-prem): appropriate if you have strict regulatory controls (HIPAA/SOC2 + specific KMS/HSM requirements) or need air-gapped inference for some workloads.

Next steps I propose:
- You send a rough monthly usage profile (tokens/month, % regulated traffic, concurrency targets).
- We schedule a technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer (30–45m) to validate perf/latency targets and migration plan.
- I'll share our migration checklist and a preliminary pricing+capacity recommendation after the deep-dive.

Attaching: Redwood pricing overview (high-level) and a migration checklist to guide the deep-dive.

If it works, can we book the deep-dive for sometime Wed/Thu this week? I can loop in Vivek (Solutions) and Dev (Security) — they can cover Dedicated sizing and the VPC/KMS options.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Diana — great context, thanks. Based on what you shared, here's a recommended phased migration approach that balances speed, risk, and compliance: 

Phase 0 — POC (2–3 weeks): Hosted API for low-risk endpoints
- Use Redwood Hosted API to validate latency and cost assumptions quickly.
- We can mirror a small % of production traffic from your OpenAI integration to Redwood for A/B comparisons.

Phase 1 — Production (4–8 weeks): Dedicated capacity for primary workloads
- Move core chat endpoints to a Dedicated pool sized to your concurrency (we'll size GPUs for 60+ concurrency and the 200–400 token average).
- Dedicated gives predictable throughput and data isolation; with reserved capacity we can meet p50 latency targets.

Phase 2 — Regulated workloads (schedule based on audit): Private VPC / customer-managed KMS
- For the ~20% PHI traffic, we recommend Private VPC with KMS integration (or on-prem if you must keep models local).
- Dev, Vivek: can you confirm what minimal reads/writes we need from Lumina's side for the VPC peering and KMS rotation test?

Migration notes to minimize downtime:
- Start with read-only shadowing/mirroring traffic to Redwood; failover only after load tests and canary rules pass.
- Use client-side routing for a gradual shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on latency/errors.
- Keep legacy cluster as a fallback for the one model you must keep local.

Next steps:
- I'll create a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and target dates and share it after our deep-dive.
- Proposed deep-dive: Thu 18 Mar 2027, 11:00–11:45am PST. Vivek (solutions) will cover sizing; Dev will cover VPC/KMS prerequisites.

If that time works, I’ll send a calendar invite and share the MAP draft + a preliminary Dedicated sizing and cost estimate.

Best,
Marissa
